name: Confirm TOTP Enrollment
summary: Verifies the authenticator code for an authenticated user with enrollment in progress and enables TOTP when the proof is accepted.

requiredInputs.description: Current time-based one-time code generated from the staged authenticator secret.

guards.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and TOTP enrollment has been started for the current durable identity

sourceReferences.note: ConfirmTotpEnrollmentAsync verifies the submitted code, enables TwoFactorEnabled, stores MFA state, and returns recovery codes.
POST /api/auth/mfatotp/enrollment/confirm delegates to the MFA manager for the current confirmed user.
